jump_rule.claim: Click piece then click empty cell 2 away orthogonally over adjacent piece: jumper moves, jumped removed. Ghost marks legal landings; piece with no landing = shake no-op.

l5 plan.claim: Start: A(4,2)->(4,4) over P1; drive L+P2 to (4,5); A(4,4)->(4,6) over P2; shift E into (4,5) as L leaves; B(4,7)->(4,5) rides E absorbs A. Then test unload-click, stub(9,3), east tunnel.

peg1.claim: Level1: click green plus to select (dark ring), ghost gray plus shows legal jump landing (2 cells over adjacent piece); click landing to move and remove jumped piece. Goal: reduce to 1 plus.
